# Web-spider profiles

Pacing presets for the background crawler that grounds the knowledge base in a watchlist of sites. Each profile is a set of fixed, model-agnostic pacing constants. Enabled with ``--spider``; bare use takes ``gentle``, and ``KEY=VALUE`` entries override any field.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("spider")``, declared in ``praxis.spider`` (2 entries)

Selected with ``--spider`` (default: unset).

## `gentle`

The default pacing: one request every 5 minutes, at most one hit per host every 30
minutes, a 16-site watchlist, and a weekly re-fetch of the stalest page once the
frontier runs dry.

## `ghost`

Development pacing, for when waiting 5 minutes per fetch is unusable: one request every
15 seconds, at most one hit per host a minute, and a re-fetch every 6 hours.
